name: Giveaway Lottery for WooCommerce
author: WebCartisan

sections.description:
🎉Giveaway Lottery for WooCommerce Plugin: Engage Customers with Exciting Online Contests and Rewards

Transform your WooCommerce store into a dynamic platform for lotteries, lucky draws, giveaways, raffle, raffle draw and online contests with our comprehensive plugin. Designed to enhance user engagement and boost sales, this tool allows you to create captivating campaigns where customers can purchase tickets for a chance to win enticing prizes and rewards. By integrating this plugin, you can create compelling campaigns that not only attract new customers but also foster loyalty among existing ones. Whether you’re running a seasonal giveaway or a recurring contest, this solution equips you with the tools to execute successful promotional events.

👉Live Demo|Documentation|Get Pro👈

✨Key Features (Free Version)

Our Giveaway Lotteries for WooCommerce Plugin comes with following features: –

Giveaway Tumber of Tickets setup foreach unit quantity
Add how many you want to sell in each giveaway, make it easier to promote your site.

👉Live Demo|Documentation

Giveaway Champaign ticket selling start date Configuration
Easily schedule when your giveaway ticket sales begin! Set a specific start date and time for each campaign to automatically open ticket sales right on schedule.

👉Live Demo|Documentation

Giveaway Ticket Sales End Date & Time Setup
Control exactly when your giveaway ticket sales will stop! Set a specific end date and time for each campaign to automatically close ticket sales.
👉Live Demo|Documentation

Giveaway Draw Date & Time Configuration
Set the exact date and time when the “Lucky draw” will take place. This allows you to schedule the contest winner announcement separately from the ticket sales period.
👉Live Demo|Documentation

Lucky Contest Ticket Range Configuration
Easily configure a customizable range of random ticket numbers for your “Lucky Draw”! Track and manage the ticket status with color indicators for sold tickets,Allocated tickets with flexible settings.
👉Live Demo|Documentation

Send Random number of tickets through email
You have a control to send individual ticket in a beautiful look to your customer through email.
👉Live Demo|Documentation

Add your logo into ticket
You can add your logo into ticket, that might enlighten your brand more.
👉Live Demo|Documentation

Show “Winner-Button” in Single product Page & Archive page
Checked to show or hide the button. This will be easier for your customer to reach your “Lucky Draw”, “Winner reveal”, “Champaign” Page.
👉Live Demo|Documentation

Change “Winner reveal” Button Text in Single Product Page & Archive page
Easily modify “Winner reveal” button label to anything you like—such as “Lucky draw,” “Champaign” or “Reward”—to better suit your store’s tone and boost engagement.
👉Live Demo|Documentation

Giveaway Reveal System (Random Winner Selection)
The Giveaway Lotteries for WooCommerce plugin includes a fully automated random
winner selection system with an integrated countdown timer.

  • ⏲️ Automatic Draw: When the giveaway timer ends, the system automatically.
  • 🎆 Winner Reveal with Fireworks: Celebrate the moment with a beautiful firework animation on the winner announcement screen.
  • 🔄 Hands-Free Operation: No manual work needed — everything happens in real time!

Change “Winner reveal” Button Text in Single Product Page & Archive page
Easily modify “Winner reveal” button label to anything you like—such as “Lucky draw,” “Champaign” or “Reward”—to better suit your store’s tone and boost engagement.
👉Live Demo|Documentation

Pro features:

👉 Ticket Settings: Add Prefix and Suffix to Giveaway Ticket Numbers
Enhance the branding and organization of your WooCommerce giveaway tickets by customizing them with prefixes and suffixes. With the Giveaway Lottery for WooCommerce plugin, you can easily add a unique identifier before or after each ticket number—perfect for distinguishing between multiple campaigns, promoting brand recognition, or organizing entries by event.

👉 Ticket Export Settings: Download Giveaway Tickets in CSV Format
Effortlessly manage your giveaway data with the Ticket Export Settings feature in the Giveaway Lottery for WooCommerce plugin. This section enables you to download all generated giveaway tickets in CSV format, including essential details like ticket numbers, order IDs, customer information, and more.
You can choose which fields to include in the export, making it easy to tailor the data for your specific needs—whether for record-keeping, offline access, manual draws, or campaign analysis.

👉 Manually Add or Deduct Giveaway Tickets for WooCommerce Orders
With the Giveaway Lottery for WooCommerce plugin, you can manually add or deduct giveaway tickets for any customer order. This flexible feature is perfect for adjusting ticket counts due to special promotions, customer service resolutions, refunds, or manual corrections.
You can even use this tool to reward loyal or VIP customers by granting them extra tickets, increasing engagement and encouraging repeat purchases. Boost participation in your lucky draw campaigns by giving deserving customers more chances to win.

👉 Pre-Define Winner by Ticket Number in WooCommerce Giveaways
With the Pre-Define Winner feature in the Giveaway Lottery for WooCommerce plugin, you can manually assign a winning ticket number before the draw takes place. This is especially useful for fixed-result giveaways, VIP customer rewards, internal contests, or employee engagement campaigns.

👉 Bonus Tickets Settings – Reward Customers with Extra Giveaway Entries
Boost customer engagement and increase sales with the Bonus Tickets Settings in the Giveaway Lottery for WooCommerce plugin. This feature allows you to automatically reward customers with bonus giveaway tickets based on predefined conditions—such as order value, specific product categories, or promotional campaigns.

👉 Expand Email Style – Customize Giveaway Emails to Match Your Brand
With the Expand Email Style feature in the Giveaway Lottery for WooCommerce plugin, you can enhance and fully customize the design of giveaway-related emails sent to your customers. Align your giveaway email templates with your brand’s visual identity, ensuring a professional and engaging experience for recipients.

👉 Countdown Timer Custom Color – Match Timer Design with Your Brand
Enhance the visual appeal of your Giveaway Lottery for WooCommerce campaigns with the Countdown Timer – Custom Color feature. This setting allows you to customize the countdown timer’s text, background, and border colors, ensuring it perfectly aligns with your site’s theme and branding.
A well-styled timer not only grabs attention but also builds urgency and encourages users to participate before the time runs out.

Many more options that will be helpful for your giveaway business. Let’s try it out.

WooXperto Team is open for you to give customization support. You might contact us for any kind of help for your giveaway system.

Let’s Enjoy 😊
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin Files: Upload the giveaway-lottery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the Plugin: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Install Required Plugins: Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Configure the Plugin: Go to ‘Giveaway Settings’ under WooCommerce settings to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
1.How do I create a giveaway campaign with Giveaway Lottery for WooCommerce?

Navigate to your WordPress dashboard, select “Add New Product,” and customize ticket
limits, dates, and number of tickets. Perfect for WooCommerce stores running contests or
raffles.

2. Can I set different ticket numbers per product quantity?

Yes! Assign specific ticket quantities to WooCommerce products.

3.How does the ticket range setup work?

Define unique ticket number ranges (e.g., 1000–2000) for each campaign to organize
entries and simplify winner selection.

4.Can I export sold ticket data with customer details?

Absolutely! Export CSV files of sold tickets, including customer names, emails, and
ticket numbers, for audits or marketing.

5.How to pre-define a winner ticket number before the draw?

Yes, you can manually set a winning ticket at pro version, ideal for transparent or
controlled raffles

6.Are email notifications sent to participants?

Yes! Customize automated emails for ticket purchases, draw reminders, and winner
announcements via WooCommerce email templates.

7.How do I schedule giveaway start, close, and draw dates?

Set exact dates/times for each phase under campaign settings. The system auto-closes
entries and announces winners on the draw date.

8.Is the winner reveal page mobile-friendly?

Winner reveals page best for operating by PC. It was build do random live draw for a
giveaway campaign, raffle draw, or lottery draw and can be live broadcast through
youtube, facebook, instagram or any other social media platform.

9.Does this plugin work with other WooCommerce extensions?

It integrates seamlessly with most WooCommerce plugins, including payment gateways
and membership tools like – woocommerce subscription plugin.

10.How is the winner selected if not pre-defined?

The plugin auto-generates a random winning ticket from sold entries, ensuring fair and
transparent draws for your campaigns.
